arxiv-1406-7438.title: Does Offline Political Segregation Affect the Filter Bubble? An Empirical Analysis of Information Diversity for Dutch and Turkish Twitter Users Journal: Computers in Human Behavior (forthcoming)
arxiv-1406-7438.creator: E. Bozdag, Q. Gao, G.J. Houben, M.E. Warnier
arxiv-1406-7438.description: Abstract From a liberal perspective, pluralism and viewpoint diversity are seen as a necessary condition for a well-functioning democracy. Recently, there have been claims that viewpoint diversity is diminishing in online social networks, putting users in a “bubble", where they receive political information which they agree with.

arxiv-2108-13514.title: ConVIScope: Visual Analytics for Exploring Patient Conversations
arxiv-2108-13514.creator: Raymond Li Enamul Hoque Giuseppe Carenini Richard Lester Raymond Chau Department of Computer Science, University of British Columbia School of Information Technology, York University Department of Medicine, University of British Columbia
arxiv-2108-13514.description: Abstract The proliferation of text messaging for mobile health is generating a large amount of patient-doctor conversations that can be extremely valuable to health care professionals. We present ConVIScope, a visual text analytic system that tightly integrates interactive visualization with natural language processing in analyzing patient-doctor conversations. ConVIScope was developed in collaboration with healthcare professionals following a user-centered iterative design.

arxiv-2302-02211.title: Performance and systematic uncertainties of CTA-North in conditions of reduced atmospheric transmission
arxiv-2302-02211.creator: and Julian Sitarek
arxiv-2302-02211.description: Abstract The Cherenkov Telescope Array (CTA) is the next-generation stereoscopic system of Imaging Atmospheric Cherenkov Telescopes (IACTs). In IACTs, the atmosphere is used as a calorimeter to measure the energy of extensive air showers induced by cosmic gamma rays, which brings along a series of constraints on the precision to which energy can be reconstructed.

arxiv-2305-08214.title: MAPPING PROPERTIES OF CERTAIN INTEGRAL OPERATORS
arxiv-2305-08214.creator: Victor Polunin, Vladimir Vasilyev, Nelly Erygina
arxiv-2305-08214.description: Abstract . We study mapping properties of two-dimensional linear integral operators in some weighted spaces with special kernels. The considered spaces are certain variant of Sobolev–Slobodetskii spaces and their generalizations related to Banach spaces. Sufficient conditions for boundedness for such operators in these spaces are obtained. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary: 45P05; Secondary: 47G10 1.

arxiv-2308-04004.description: Abstract The so-called “unidentified infrared emission” (UIE) features at 3.3, 6.2, 7.7, 8.6, and 11.3 μ ​ m \,{\rm\mu m} ubiquitously seen in a wide variety of astrophysical regions are generally attributed to polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon (PAH) molecules. arxiv-2311-03586.title: Characterization of a Far-Infrared Kinetic Inductance Detector Prototype for PRIMA
arxiv-2311-03586.creator: Steven Hailey-Dunsheath, Sven van Berkel, Andrew D. Beyer, Logan Foote, Reinier M. J. Janssen, Henry G. LeDuc, Pierre M. Echternach, Charles M. Bradford, Jochem J. A. Baselmans, Shahab Dabironezare, Peter K. Day, Nicholas F. Cothard, Jason Glenn

Echternach, Charles M. Bradford, Jochem J. A. Baselmans, Shahab Dabironezare, Peter K. Day, Nicholas F. Cothard, Jason Glenn. arxiv-2312-01406.creator: Shoulong Li, H. Lü, Yong Gao, Rui Xu, Lijing Shao, Hongwei Yu

It is commonly believed that black holes are the smallest self-gravitating objects of the same mass in the Universe. arxiv-2401-05658.title: Twisting shadows: light rings, lensing and shadows of black holes in swirling universes
arxiv-2401-05658.creator: Zeus S. Moreira, Carlos A. R. Herdeiro, Luís C. B. Crispino
arxiv-2401-05658.description: Abstract Using the Ernst formalism, a novel solution of vacuum General Relativity was recently obtained Astorino et al. 2022 , describing a Schwarzschild black hole (BH) immersed in a non-asymptotically flat rotating background, dubbed swirling universe , with the peculiar property that north and south hemispheres spin in opposite directions.

arxiv-2410-04295.title: ExoMol line lists – LX. Molecular line list for the ammonia isotopologue 15 NH 3
arxiv-2410-04295.creator: Sergei N. Yurchenko, Charles A. Bowesman, Ryan P. Brady, Elizabeth R. Guest, Kyriaki Kefala, Georgi B. Mitev, Alec Owens, Armando N. Perri, Marco Pezzella, Oleksiy Smola, Andrei Sokolov, Jingxin Zhang, Jonathan Tennyson
arxiv-2410-04295.description: Abstract A theoretical line list for 15 NH 3 CoYuTe-15 is presented based on the empirical potential energy and ab initio dipole moments surfaces developed and used for the production of the ExoMol line list CoYuTe for 14 NH 3 . The ro-vibrational energy levels and wavefunctions are computed using the variational program TROVE.

arxiv-2411-02421.title: Near-Optimal Quantum Algorithm for Finding the Longest Common Substring between Run-Length Encoded Strings
arxiv-2411-02421.creator: Tzu-Ching Lee, Han-Hsuan Lin
arxiv-2411-02421.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tzu-Ching Lee, Han-Hsuan Lin. We give a near-optimal quantum algorithm for the longest common substring (LCS) problem between two run-length encoded (RLE) strings, with the assumption that the prefix-sums of the run-lengths are given.

arxiv-2502-18315.title: GraphRank Pro+: Advancing Talent Analytics Through Knowledge Graphs and Sentiment-Enhanced Skill Profiling
arxiv-2502-18315.creator: Dr. Sirisha Velampalli 1, Chandrashekar Muniyappa 2
arxiv-2502-18315.description: Abstract The extraction of information from semi-structured text, such as resumes, has long been a challenge due to the diverse formatting styles and subjective content organization. Conventional solutions rely on specialized logic tailored for specific use cases. However, we propose a revolutionary approach leveraging structured Graphs, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Deep Learning.

arxiv-2505-14491.title: Neutrinophilic Super-Resonant Dark Matter
arxiv-2505-14491.creator: Murat Abdughani, Shao-Song Tang, Kadirya Tursun, Bin Zhu
arxiv-2505-14491.description: Abstract Dark matter (DM) annihilation can be significantly enhanced through narrow resonances or the Sommerfeld enhancement effect, with both mechanisms potentially combining in a super-resonant annihilation process. In such scenarios, the conventional assumption that kinetic equilibrium persists until chemical decoupling may not hold, leading to substantial impacts on the final DM relic density.

arxiv-2603-11462.creator: Yuxiang Liu, Qiao Liu, Tong Luo, Yanglei Gan, Peng He, and Yao Liu🖂

pmc-10636912.title: Designing for community engagement: user-friendly refugee wellness center planning process and concept, a health design case study
pmc-10636912.creator: Ellen Solomon, Brandon Joa, Shandon Coffman, Billie Faircloth, Marc Altshuler, Bon Ku
pmc-10636912.description: BackgroundRefugee and immigrant populations have diverse cultural factors that affect their access to health care and must be considered when building a new clinical space. Health design thinking can help a clinical team evaluate and consolidate these factors while maintaining close contact with architects, patients’ community leaders, and hospital or institutional leadership.

pmc-10704770.title: Combined utility of Ki-67 index and tumor grade to stratify patients with pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma who underwent upfront surgery
pmc-10704770.creator: Bo Li, Xiaoyi Yin, Xiuwen Ding, Guoxiao Zhang, Hui Jiang, Cuimin Chen, Shiwei Guo, Gang Jin
pmc-10704770.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the prognostic prediction of a new indicator, combined by tumor grade and Ki-67, in patients with resected pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC).MethodsData were retrospectively collected from consecutive patients who underwent primary resection of pancreas from December 2012 to December 2017. Tumor grade and Ki-67 were reviewed from routine pathological reports.

pmc-11635974.title: Magnetism and Thermoelectric Properties of the Zintl Semiconductor: Eu21Zn4As18
pmc-11635974.creator: Md. Minhajul Islam, Maria Wróblewska, Zihao Shen, Eric S. Toberer, Valentin Taufour, Susan M. Kauzlarich
pmc-11635974.description: Compositional diversity and intriguing structural features have made Zintl phases excellent candidates as thermoelectric materials. Zintl phase with 21-4-18 composition has shown high thermoelectric performance in the mid- to high-temperature ranges. The complex crystal structure and favorable transport properties of these compounds indicate the potential for high thermoelectric efficiency.

pmc-12433894.title: The Effect of Behavioral Intervention on Maternal Breastfeeding Practice and Infant Growth in Congenital Heart Disease: A Randomized Controlled Trial
pmc-12433894.creator: Huimei Wang, Qi Zhang, Yu Sun, Xueping Zhang, Yuehong Ren, Yalan Dou, Chuyi Zhan, Ming Ye, Ying Gu
pmc-12433894.description: Breastfeeding offers critical health benefits for infants, including those with mild congenital heart disease (CHD). However, breastfeeding in this population faces multifaceted challenges. At the individual level, maternal anxiety associated with the CHD diagnosis may undermine breastfeeding confidence; at the systemic level, institutional support for establishing and sustaining breastfeeding remains inadequate. Behavioral interventions may influence feeding practices for these infants.

pmc-12519624.title: Extracellular vesicles in metabolic perspective: mechanism and targeted therapy
pmc-12519624.creator: Qifeng Sheng, Zebin Wu, Wenming Li, Liangliang Wang, Hao Xu, Wentao Wang, Zhanjun Yan, Gaoran Ge, Yaozeng Xu, Dechun Geng
pmc-12519624.description: Intercellular metabolic communication is essential for maintaining homeostasis and normal physiological function. Extracellular vesicles (EVs), as key mediators of cell-to-cell communication, are increasingly recognized for their close association with metabolic regulation. EVs encapsulate and transport bioactive molecules—including metabolites, enzymes, nucleic acids, and proteins—that directly influence intracellular pathways such as energy supply, RNA and protein synthesis, and organelle function.

pmc-12645703.title: Viromic analysis of cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) samples identified an unclassified RNA virus exhibiting an atypical genomic architecture
pmc-12645703.creator: Ju Zhang, Yi Zhao, Wang Li, Juan Xu, Yue Chen, Shixing Yang, Ping Wu, Yuefeng Li, Chenglin Zhou, Wen Zhang
pmc-12645703.description: The central nervous system (CNS) is highly susceptible to infections that can lead to severe neurological morbidity and mortality. Despite advances in diagnostic technologies, a significant proportion of encephalitis and meningitis cases remain etiologically undiagnosed, underscoring the need for novel pathogen discovery approaches.

pmc-12735152.title: Multifunctional Nanoplatforms Bridging Diagnostics and Therapeutics in Cancer
pmc-12735152.creator: Hossein Omidian, Erma J. Gill
pmc-12735152.description: Accurate tumor visualization remains a central challenge in oncology, as single-modality imaging often lacks the depth, sensitivity, and specificity needed for precise therapeutic guidance. Nano-theranostic platforms address this by combining multimodal imaging with tumor-responsive activation and therapeutic functions within a single system.

pmc-13116673.title: Radiographic Clarity of the External Auditory Meatus as a Cranial Reference Point in Spinal Deformity Patients: A Pilot Interobserver Study
pmc-13116673.creator: Dongkyu Kim, Dong Kyu Chin, Sejun Park, Jaemin Kim, Insu Lee, Jun-Woo Ha, Hyun Jun Jang, Kyung Hyun Kim, Jeong Yoon Park, Sung Uk Kuh, Keun Su Kim, Pyung Goo Cho, Bong Ju Moon
pmc-13116673.description: Background/Objectives: The external auditory meatus (EAM) is widely used as a surrogate cranial reference point, based on its proximity to the midpoint of the nasion–inion line (MNI). However, its radiographic clarity has not been thoroughly validated. This study aimed to evaluate the radiographic clarity and interobserver reproducibility of the EAM compared with the sella turcica as a control landmark.

pmc-13547187.title: Lactate-associated H3K18la upregulates RNF166 to promote immune evasion in hepatocellular carcinoma by remodeling c-Jun ubiquitination
pmc-13547187.creator: Bingyi Ren, Yichen Yang, Kai Sheng, Qiuyu Mu, Zhiyuan Bai, Min Tian, Yang Ren, Yi Lv, Kang Liu
pmc-13547187.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is a leading cause of cancer-related mortality, and PD-L1-mediated immune evasion is a major mechanism of tumor immune suppression and an important target of immune checkpoint blockade. Here, we identified RNF166 as an E3 ubiquitin ligase that promotes immune evasion in HCC.

pmc-13576279.title: Travel vaccination in senior travelers: current evidence, challenges, and prevention
pmc-13576279.creator: Andrea Rossanese, Alberto Tomasi
pmc-13576279.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The substantial number of older adults undertaking international travel has increased the relevance of pre-travel prevention in this population. However, vaccination strategies in this group require consideration of immune aging, baseline status, medication use, and travel-related exposure. This narrative review summarizes the current evidence on vaccination in senior travelers, with particular attention to the vaccines most relevant to this population, the differences in the strength of evidence across vaccines, and the clinical factors that should guide pre-travel decision-making.
